Name: Lucikiel Anime Portraits for 1.6 (Portraiture)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
Lucikiel's Anime Portraits by [b][color=#e69138]Kono437816[/color][/b] finally work with Portraiture in SDV 1.6! Special thanks to AarlaunaRose for the help!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/VOQ4S60.png[/img]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=description]Portraiture[/url]. Unzip the downloaded folder "Lucikiel Portraiture" folder into Mods > Portraiture > Portraits. Press 'P' to switch portraits between Vanilla/Airyn (depending on your configs from main Lucikiel mod) and Anime when talking to Lucikiel.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sa2zAoG.png[/img]

Downloads.Description:
Make sure to download Portraiture.

Unzip downloaded folder into "Mods > Portraiture > Portraits". When talking to Lucikiel, press "P" to switch to Kono's anime portraits.
